pilots.wake_provenance_text:
# Wake GeoGuard pilot provenance

## AOI

- Role: `train`
- Status: `verified_pilot`
- Geography: southern Wake County, North Carolina, United States
- Evaluation CRS: NAD83(2011) / UTM zone 17N (`EPSG:6346`)
- Evaluation bounds: `717954, 3944392, 718954, 3945392`
- Evaluation size: exactly 1,000 m Ã— 1,000 m
- WGS84 bounding box (axis-aligned envelope): `-78.5934617121, 35.6190853456, -78.5821576525, 35.6283148797`

The U.S. Census TIGERweb State/County service returned only Wake County (`GEOID 37183`) for the evaluation envelope.

## Source metadata table

| Role | Provider and exact product | Acquisition | Native grid/reference | Licence/access |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| RGB | USDA-FSA NAIP `m_3507828_nw_17_1_20140618` | 2014-06-18 | 1 m, 4-band RGBNIR, NAD83 / UTM 17N (`EPSG:26917`) | U.S. public domain; open cloud mirror used |
| Coarse reference | Copernicus DEM GLO-30 `Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N35_00_W079_00_DEM` | TanDEM-X source epoch 2011â€“2015 | DSM, 1 arc-second (~30 m), WGS84-G1150 / geographic (`EPSG:4326`), EGM2008 (`EPSG:3855`), metres | Free Copernicus DEM licence; attribution required; public COG endpoint used |
| Independent truth | USGS 3DEP LPC `NC_Phase2_2014`, tile `LA_37_20162803_` | 2014-02-09 for this tile; project range 2014-01-30 to 2014-03-13 | Classified LAS 1.3, nominal 0.7 m post spacing, NAD83(2011) / NC ftUS (`EPSG:6543`), NAVD88/Geoid12A, US survey feet | U.S. public-domain government data; USGS use/disclaimer terms apply |

RGB and truth are separated by 129 days. They are same-year acquisitions, but LiDAR was leaf-off and NAIP was leaf-on; vegetation surfaces can therefore differ materially. Copernicus GLO-30 is an independent radar-derived product and does not use this USGS LiDAR tile as its source.

## Exact source URLs

- NAIP STAC item: `https://planetarycomputer.microsoft.com/api/stac/v1/collections/naip/items/nc_m_3507828_nw_17_1_20140618_20141118`
- NAIP image: `https://naipeuwest.blob.core.windows.net/naip/v002/nc/2014/nc_100cm_2014/35078/m_3507828_nw_17_1_20140618.tif`
- NAIP FGDC metadata: `https://naipeuwest.blob.core.windows.net/naip/v002/nc/2014/nc_fgdc_2014/35078/m_3507828_nw_17_1_20140618.txt`
- Copernicus GLO-30 tile: `https://copernicus-dem-30m.s3.amazonaws.com/Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N35_00_W079_00_DEM/Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N35_00_W079_00_DEM.tif`
- Copernicus product documentation: `https://dataspace.copernicus.eu/sites/default/files/media/files/2024-06/geo1988-copernicusdem-spe-002_producthandbook_i5.0.pdf`
- USGS TNM product API: `https://tnmaccess.nationalmap.gov/api/v1/products?bbox=-78.5934617121%2C35.6190853456%2C-78.5821576525%2C35.6283148797&datasets=Lidar+Point+Cloud+%28LPC%29&max=100`
- USGS LAZ: `https://rockyweb.usgs.gov/vdelivery/Datasets/Staged/Elevation/LPC/Projects/NC_Phase2_2014/NC_JohnstonCo_2014/LAZ/USGS_LPC_NC_Phase2_2014_LA_37_20162803_.laz`
- USGS classified-point metadata: `https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/Elevation/metadata/NC_Phase2_2014/NC_JohnstonCo_2014/reports/xmls/ngtoc_created_xml/NC_Phase2_ClassifiedPointCloud.xml`
- NOAA VDatum API documentation: `https://vdatum.noaa.gov/docs/services.html`

## Surface-truth derivation

The truth is a surface DSM, not a bare-earth DTM. The source contains classes 1 (unclassified), 2 (ground), 3â€“5 (vegetation), 6 (building), 7 (noise), 13 (road), 17 (overlap default), and 18 (overlap ground) within this AOI. The rasterizer accepts classes `1,2,3,4,5,6,9,10,13,14`, excludes noise classes `7,11`, excludes overlap duplicates `17,18`, and excludes withheld points. Each 1 m cell stores the maximum accepted Z. Cells without an accepted point remain nodata (`-9999`). Z values are converted from US survey feet using exactly `0.3048006096012192` metres per US survey foot.

- Accepted points: 3,297,861
- Valid truth cells: 962,159 / 1,000,000 (96.2159%)
- Valid-cell point density: minimum 1, median 3, maximum 20 points per 1 m cell
- Truth elevation range: 58.506477â€“131.518417 m NAVD88/Geoid12A

## Alignment and vertical conversion

All aligned products use the exact truth grid: 1 m pixels, 1,000 Ã— 1,000 cells, `EPSG:6346`, with no truth-driven registration optimization.

- RGB: bands 1â€“3, bilinear horizontal reprojection.
- Reference: bilinear horizontal reprojection from the native GLO-30 grid. This interpolation does not create new independent spatial information; the effective source resolution remains ~30 m.
- Truth: direct maximum-Z binning of classified LiDAR points; no image resize and no elevation interpolation.
- Valid mask: `1` only where RGB, reference, and truth are all valid.

GLO-30 elevations were converted from EGM2008 metres to NAVD88/Geoid12A metres with NOAA VDatum. VDatum requires the EGM2008-associated WGS84-G1674 realization; Copernicus documents WGS84-G1150 horizontally. This realization difference is negligible relative to a 30 m cell but is recorded as an approximation. VDatum returned these corner corrections, bilinearly interpolated across the AOI:

- top-left: +0.273 m
- top-right: +0.275 m
- bottom-left: +0.275 m
- bottom-right: +0.277 m

The NOAA API returned `NaN` for transformation uncertainty, so vertical-conversion uncertainty is unquantified and must not be represented as zero.

## Checksums

- Raw NAIP AOI crop: `09a39ec87dff6dfe53a32a1c2159e885677544eb664d8541356ae9ab8b7105f5`
- Raw GLO-30 AOI crop: `9670e72079ffbffef167d03eb53789b059fcb8d95172f3c080b2a9e78b0b2bc7`
- Raw USGS LAZ tile: `47d2e62a80d989519458a62504f790fbf3c6cf1bdb56d537952b8681f5215392`
- Aligned RGB: `a0828aa36ff4d33a7e807db1ce704d1d26c3664d606b57df2353eec0df4a0bc8`
- Aligned reference: `5782c883488abb444264b7d8fb4072b008297d806d93af66c2e846088767c57c`
- Aligned truth: `92e8304c1ef8e51e74ab8f2de4af81c1341ce45a498103e7c30f95fc35f87355`

## Scientific limitations

- The RGBâ€“truth phenology mismatch makes canopy-level residuals partly temporal, not purely model error.
- GLO-30 is a coarse DSM; its 1 m aligned raster is an interpolated analytical copy, not 1 m source information.
- GLO-30â€™s multi-year acquisition epoch cannot be reduced to an exact date for this cell.
- VDatum supplied a correction but no numeric uncertainty.
- Maximum-return rasterization is sensitive to sparse high returns and does not guarantee a watertight roof/canopy surface in every cell.
- This is a development/training pilot only. It is not a blind-test geography and must not be used to claim generalization.
